about: Every Federal Register document since 2022 that changes how SSI counts income or in-kind support (20 CFR Part 416), and every SSA notice of the year's SSI amounts since 2024, with what Giftwise does with it. src/lib/rules-watch.ts asks the Federal Register for the same lists live and names any document not listed here.

documents.title: Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2027
documents.how: In use: $1,029 a month for one person and $1,544 for a couple for checks paid from January 2027, with the one-third reduction and the presumed maximum value following the new rate (POMS SI 02005.001 E.4.c).

documents.title: Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2026
documents.how: In use: $994 a month for one person and $1,491 for a couple for checks paid in 2026.

documents.title: Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2025
documents.how: The 2025 amounts, for checks paid before Giftwise's first year.

documents.title: Expand the Definition of a Public Assistance Household
documents.how: In a public assistance household, including one that gets SNAP, help from the household is not counted as in-kind support. The routes Giftwise uses keep the check whole in either case.

documents.title: Expansion of the Rental Subsidy Policy for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Applicants and Recipients
documents.how: Rent below market value is a rental subsidy, a separate calculation from a gift; SSA's examples of it are listed on /evidence with what each is about.

documents.title: Omitting Food From In-Kind Support and Maintenance Calculations
documents.how: Followed: food is not in-kind support from September 30, 2024 (rule R-FOOD-01), and the one-third reduction applies only when the household provides all meals (20 CFR 416.1131(a)(3)).
